prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE DIAMOND suit pip master belonging to the EXACT SAME playing-card design family as the supplied spade, which is a STYLE reference. Match its ornate Ming/Tang silk lotus painting, line weight, double antique-gold beaded perimeter, ivory-and-madder-red central lotus rosette, teal/verdigris leaves, curling gold stems, and ONE small round turquoise center jewel in a gold rim.
Recompose the ornament inside an unmistakable upright DIAMOND RHOMBUS: exactly FOUR STRAIGHT sides and FOUR SHARP vertices at top, right, bottom, left. Moderately tall diamond, width about 75 percent of height. No curved sides, no scalloped outline, no lobes, no stem. Rich Madder Lake red #A73443 body instead of the spade's black body, retaining ample visible red negative space between ornaments. The central rosette and jewel at the exact geometric center, balanced paired foliage, small lotus buds toward the upper and lower tips; ornament wholly contained inside the straight gold diamond outline. Keep the central flower large and legible; narrow tips need simpler decoration, no overcrowding.
Clean readable silhouette even when downscaled to 100 pixels tall. One diamond fully visible, centered with generous transparent padding on every side, square canvas about 1254x1254 matching the reference scale. Actual transparent alpha outside the silhouette, no opaque background and no painted checkerboard. Crisp print illustration with restrained shading exactly like the reference. No spade, other symbols, card, border around the canvas, text, numerals, A, outside ornament, shadow, watermark, or 3D rendering. This is a reusable prototype for both an ace and smaller numeral pips.
